the spatial distribution of economic activities in Beijing is determined by the interaction of the governmental force and the market force, and that the governmental force dominates the urban core while the market force dominates the urban fringe.
the government is more powerful in the urban core than in the suburban area, and the spatial distribution of each industry is affected by both governmental and market forces.
the spatial distribution of Beijing industries is a reflection of the influence exerted by the government and the markets, and the government has a stronger impact in the urban core.

the spatial distribution of industrial activities and their determinants in transitional China, a country that is currently undergoing a transition from planned to market economy.
the spatial distribution of economic sectors, and the reasons behind it.
the spatial distribution of economic activities, which is a fundamental issue in the study of regional economic growth.

the government and the markets are both important forces that shape the spatial distribution of Chinese industry.
the spatial distribution of Chinese industries has been shaped by the interplay of governmental force and the market force.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the industrial spatial pattern is determined by the interaction between the government and the markets.

The main takeaway from our work is that

, although China is a country undergoing a transition from planned economy to market economy, the government still plays a dominant role in shaping its spatial industrial pattern, and this is especially the case in the urban core.
the spatial distribution of economic sectors is not a simple reflection of the laws of market economy, but rather a result of the interaction between the market forces and governmental forces.

the spatial distribution of industrial activities in a transitional economy is the result of the interaction between the government and the markets, and the government is the main driving force of industrial location.
